verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke's own EC&VC page says it supports venture-backed companies 'from incorporation through to exit' and guides clients through strategic M&A, private equity processes and secondary transactions, and works as an IPO adviser. A concrete case study backs the M&A side: it advised Flock from start-up through its £80m acquisition by Admiral Group. Missing for 10: no IPO case study or deal examples (IPO work is only a one-line service mention), and no independent corroboration of exit track record.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm can carry the company through to exit — M&A and public-offering experience for venture-backed companies is documented on its own pages
